title: Ray's Baptismal Day Men in Suits, 1955 Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A 1955 black and white snapshot photograph depicting two men dressed in formal suits standing in a grassy yard for Ray's Baptismal Day on April 17, 1955. Behind them sits a low wooden picket fence, a small white house, and mountain scenery in the distance. The shadow of the person taking the photograph is cast on the grass in the foreground.
